correctness.rationale: For n≥4 the characteristic derived ideal and the relation [e2,e3]=0 force the e1 component of σ(e2) to vanish (u·det=0), so every automorphism has triangular form determined uniquely by a,b∈F_q^× and 2n−3 free coefficients. Its diagonal weights are a,b,ab,a²b,…,a^(n−2)b. No fixed vector is equivalent to none of those weights being 1. For element a of order d>1, exactly min(d,n−1) values b are excluded; summing φ(d)(q−1−min(d,n−1)) and multiplying by q^(2n−3) proves all dimensions/finite characteristics, the existence criterion, and n=4 formulas. Independent direct exponent-pair counts covered 16 prime powers q=2..64 and n=4..12 (144 cases) and matched divisor sum, with proof handling unbounded n/q.
residual_risks: The formula is restricted to standard filiform Ln n≥4, not arbitrary filiform deformations or Heisenberg H3.
